note: Small non-modern campground on one wooded loop in the hills just southwest of Estherville. Water from a hydrant; dumpster at the entrance. --Claude
summary: Confirmed fees ($10/$12 non-electric, $18/$20 electric), 16 sites (8 electric 20/30/50A, 8 non-electric), 66-ft max, pit latrine, 100% reservable. Fit: 15 of 16 sites take a 23-ft rig (site 16 is 20 ft). Season filled Apr 15 - Oct 31 (the note's 'mid-June through mid-September' was stale). Not waterfront confirmed. Pin ~790 m off; corrected.
flags: PIN (~790 m off): stored 43.39516,-94.87627 is northwest of the campground. The 16 RA site points centre on 43.39039,-94.86897 (range 43.39011-43.39067, -94.86918 to -94.86872). Proposed 43.39039,-94.86897.

SEASON: RA says 'closed each year from November 1 - April 14' and takes reservations April 15 - October 31. The stored note said 'roughly mid-June through mid-September', which no current source supports.
FIT: electric sites 28-66 ft and non-electric sites 30-40 ft fit a 23-ft motorhome; only non-electric site 16 (20 ft) doesn't.
PHONE: none stored, and the DNR park page gives none for the park (only the DNR's central 515-725-8200).
WATERFRONT (not waterfront confirmed): the loop sits under continuous canopy on a wooded hillside; no water nearby on NAIP.
Note: the stored note repeated the site counts, lengths, toilets and booking. Cleaned.
